pending.body: Add validation for `chloride_protection_factor` in `validate_shrimp_runtime_params()` (invariants.rs). Currently `critical_molt_gh_ratio`, `molt_success_threshold`, and all other named shrimp parameters are validated, but `chloride_protection_factor` has no bounds check. A negative or NaN value would silently break the hazard formula (the `.max(0.0)` inside `compute_effective_nitrite_hazard` handles negatives at runtime, but NaN/Infinity would propagate). Add `check_non_negative("shrimp_params.chloride_protection_factor", params.chloride_protection_factor)?;` alongside the existing parameter checks, and add a corresponding invalid-value test case to the `malformed_current_save_with_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_is_rejected` and `step_hours_rejects_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_before_simulation` tests.
